title: Move load_port off unwrap
summary: Three unwraps become ? with context, then the missing line falls back to a default.

turns.user: load_port panics the moment the config file is slightly off. drop the unwraps, return anyhow

assistant.body: Certainly. The return type becomes anyhow::Result<u16> and all three unwraps become ?. The read gets a context line, and the missing entry is an Option, so anyhow! turns it into an error.

turns.user: actually no, if there's no port line just use 8080. don't error

assistant.body: Understood. A None from find returns Ok(8080) straight away. anyhow! is no longer used, so it leaves the import too.
